This '''unidentified Tibanna gas miner''' was one of the many working on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] for greedy corporations exploiting [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]]. They were unconcerned with any environmental repercussions from his work.<ref name="CCL" />
